mil5.4.10:1.4: Tathāgatena SāriputtaMoggallānapamukhe bhikkhusanghe paṇāmite Cātumeyyakā ca Sakyā Brahmā ca Sahampati bījūpamañ-ca vacchataruṇūpamañ-ca upadassetvā Bhagavantaṃ pasādesuṃ khamāpesuṃ nijjhattaṃ akaṃsūti.
mil5.4.10:1.5: Kin-nu kho bhante Nāgasena aññātā tā upamā Tathāgatassa yāhi Tathāgato upamāhi orato khamito upasanto nijjhattiṃ gato.
mil5.4.10:1.6: Yadi bhante Nāgasena Tathāgatassa tā upamā aññātā, tena hi Buddho asabbaññū; yadi ñātā, tena hi okassa pasayha vīmaṃsāpekho paṇāmesi, tena hi tassa akāruññatā sambhavati.
mil5.4.10:1.7: Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.4.10:2.1: Sabbaññū mahārāja Tathāgato, tāhi ca upamāhi Bhagavā pasanno orato khamito upasanto nijjhattiṃ gato.
mil5.4.10:2.2: Dhammasāmī mahārāja Tathāgato, Tathāgatappavediteh' eva te opammehi Tathāgataṃ ārādhesuṃ tosesuṃ pasādesuṃ, tesañ-ca Tathāgato pasanno sādhūti abbhanumodi.
mil5.4.10:3.1: Yathā mahārāja itthī sāmikassa santaken' eva dhanena sāmikaṃ ārādheti toseti pasādeti, tañ-ca sāmiko sādhūti abbhanumodati,
mil5.4.10:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja Cātumeyyakā ca Sakyā Brahmā ca Sahampati Tathāgatappavediteh' eva opammehi Tathāgataṃ ārādhesuṃ tosesuṃ pasādesuṃ, tesañ-ca Tathāgato pasanno sādhūti abbhanumodi.
mil5.4.10:4.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja kappako rañño santaken' eva suvaṇṇapaṇakena rañño uttamangaṃ pasādhayamāno rājānaṃ ārādheti toseti pasādeti, tassa ca rājā pasanno sādhūti abbhanumodati yathicchitam-anuppadeti;
mil5.4.10:4.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja Cātumeyyakā ca Sakyā Brahmā ca Sahampati Tathāgatappavediteh' eva opammehi Tathāgataṃ ārādhesuṃ tosesuṃ pasādesuṃ, tesañ-ca Tathāgato pasanno sādhūti abbhanumodi.
mil5.4.10:5.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja saddhivihāriko upajjhāyābhataṃ piṇḍapātaṃ gahetvā upajjhāyassa upanāmento upajjhāyaṃ ārādheti toseti pasādeti, tañ-ca upajjhāyo pasanno sādhūti abbhanumodati;
mil5.4.10:5.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja Cātumeyyakā ca Sakyā Brahmā ca Sahampati Tathāgatappavediteh' eva opammehi Tathāgataṃ ārādhesuṃ tosesuṃ pasādesuṃ, tesañ-ca Tathāgato pasanno sādhūti abbhanumoditvā sabbadukkhaparimuttiyā dhammaṃ desesīti. -
mil5.4.10:5.3: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
